drhp.business: We are engaged in supplying a comprehensive range of consumer electronic products. Our product portfolio includes LED TVs, Air Coolers, Washing Machines and Air Conditioners. Our products are marketed under our flagship brand, “Wiscon,” serving both (B-to-B) and (B-to-C) customers within India.
drhp.one_liner: Our Promoter and Managing Director, Mr. Sidhant Dalmia has an overall 7 years of work experience in the industry in which our company operates.
risks: Our business operations rely significantly on the continuous and timely supply of products from top 5 and top 10 suppliers.

Our purchases of stock-in-trade from top 10 suppliers are 99.77%, 99.33%, 99.82% and 99.97% for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024 respectively on the basis of Restated Standalone Financial Statements, accordingly, this exposes us to a concentration of purchases from top 10 suppliers and also, any interruptions or discontinuation of same will adversely impact our overall performance and profitability.
Our products are marketed under our flagship brand, “Wiscon,” serving both (B-to-B) and (B-to-C) customers within India.
We usually do not enter into long-term supply contracts with any of our suppliers.

We procure these products typically through purchase orders which sets out the terms and conditions in relation to quantity, pricing and delivery details and do not enter into any continuing and exclusive supply agreements with our suppliers.

If our suppliers do not perform their obligations in a timely manner or cease operations or decide to discontinue our supply relationships, or at all, we would need to find alternative suppliers, within a requisite span of time.

While we have not experienced any instance where any of our suppliers did not fulfil their obligations in a timely manner in the last three Fiscals and for the period ended on June 30, 2026 that resulted in an adverse impact on our operations, we cannot assure that such instances will not arise in the future.

Although we have not experienced any instances during the last three years and for the period ended on June 30, 2026 where our Company faced shortages, delayed deliveries or supply disruptions from our key suppliers where they were unable to supply us desired quantities of products or where we could not find a replacement for any particular supplier in the last three Fiscals and for the period ended on June 30, 2026, we cannot assure you that such instances will not arise in future.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Despite evolving global uncertainties, investor interest remains intact across key sectors, backed by policy stability and structural growth drivers.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: As of October 2025, India is projected to become the fourth largest market for consumer durables by FY27, with the sector growing at an 11% CAGR.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The market size is expected to reach Rs. 3 lakh crore (US$ 33.6 billion) by FY29, driven by increasing affluence, household penetration, premiumization, and technology-driven demand for smart and energy-efficient appliances.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: India’s appliances and consumer electronics sector is expected to grow at a ~11% CAGR, reaching Rs. 3,00,000 crore (US$ 36.1 billion) by FY29, driven by premiumisation and rising demand for smart, AI-enabled products.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY • In 2025*, the refrigerator, washing machines and air conditioner revenue were estimated around Rs. 1,06,208 crore (US$ 12.12 billion), Rs. 43, 552 crore (US$ 4.97 billion) and Rs. 65,598 crore (US$ 7.52 billion), respectively. • As of 2025*, India’s dishwasher market is valued between Rs. 596 crore (US$ 68 million) and Rs. 745 crore (US$ 85 million).

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The market is projected to expand at a CAGR of 3-12% over the next ten years, with annual sales expected to surpass 1,85,000 units by 2030. • As of 2024, India is the fastest-growing major market in the world and is expected to become the fourth-largest market for consumer durables by FY27, driven by favourable demand-side and supply-side tailwinds. • India’s mobile manufacturing surged from just 2 units in 2014 to over 300 as of FY25.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Domestic production rose from 26% in FY15 to 99.2% as of FY25, with output value jumping from Rs. 18,900 crore (US$ 2.14 billion) (FY14) to Rs. 4.22 lakh crore (US$ 47.88 billion) (FY24). • India’s luggage industry is projected to reach Rs. 26,700 crore (US$ 3.02 billion) by 2028, growing at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 12% between 2023 and 2028, according to a report by Motilal Oswal.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: MARKET OVERVIEW The consumer durables market is split into two key segments: GROWTH IN CONSUMER DURABLES • According to a report by EY Parthenon and CII, India's consumer durables sector is projected to grow at a CAGR of 11%, reaching Rs. 3 lakh crore (US$ 35.73 billion) by 2029. • India's consumer durables sector, currently contributing 0.6% to GDP as of FY25, aims to boost its share by 1.5 times and become the fourthlargest market by 2027.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: Refrigerators • In 2025*, India’s refrigerator market is valued at Rs. 1,06,207 crore (US$ 12.12 billion) and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 9.01% during 2025–30. 5.

overview.business_overview:
We are engaged in supplying a comprehensive range of consumer electronic products. Our product portfolio includes LED TVs, Air Coolers, Washing Machines and Air Conditioners. Our products are marketed under our flagship brand, “Wiscon,” serving both (B-to-B) and (B-to-C) customers within India. We are a Delhi-based company specializing in a wide range of consumer electronic products. Further we also sell Electric Scooters in the name of third-party brand. For the Financial Year 2026, our revenue from operations was ₹7,339.16 Lakhs, representing steady growth from ₹1,449.27 Lakhs for the Financial Year 2024-25 and ₹321.45 Lakhs for the Financial Year 2023-24 as per Restated Standalone Financial Statements, growing at a CAGR of 377.82% between the Financial Years 2023-24 and 2025-26. Further, revenue from operations as per Restated Consolidated Financial Statements for the FY 2025-26 was ₹19,687.46 Lakhs. Our revenue from operations for the period ended June 30, 2026, was ₹2,432.27 as per Restated Standalone Financial Statements and ₹6,984.84 as per Restated Consolidated Financial Statements.

Our Company was established in the year 2022 as a Public Limited Company under the name Wiscon Industries Limited vide Certificate of Incorporation dated September 16, 2022 issued by Registrar of Companies, Central Registration Centre with Mr. Sidhant Dalmia, Mr. Sanjay Kumar Shah, Mr. Mukesh Kumar, Mr. Angad Pal Singh Bicaps, Mr. Vardeep Singh Hora, Ms. Meghpreet Kaur and Mr. Anand Kumar Mishra as the initial subscribers to the Memorandum of Association of our Company. Subsequently the Objects of our company were changed vide Board Resolutions dated May 08, 2026 and Special Resolution passed by Shareholders at the Extra Ordinary General Meeting of our company held on May 18, 2026. The fresh Certificate of Registration of the Special Resolution Confirming Alteration of Object Clause was issued pursuant to special Resolution together with the copy of the Memorandum of Association as altered has this day been registered on June 3, 2026 by Registrar of Companies, Delhi. Subsequently corporate identification number of our Company was changed from U32109DL2022PLC404671 to U46522DL2022PLC404671. Our Company is currently being promoted by Mr. Sidhant Dalmia. Our Promoter and Managing Director, Mr. Sidhant Dalmia has an overall 7 years of work experience in the industry in which our company operates. Our Promoter manages and control the overall affairs of our Business Operations with his considerable experience in our Industry. For more details, please see the chapter titled, “Our Management” and “Our Promoters and Promoter Group” on page 243 and 259 of this Red Herring Prospectus.

We operate our customer network through Business to Business (B-to-B) and Business to Consumers (B-to-C) platform. In Business to Business (B-to-B) network we operate through our offline network of customers and in Business to Consumers (B-to-C) platform we operate through our website. Our customer-centric approach aims to fulfil the daily and targeted requirements of the end customers with a focus on affordability, quality and convenience. Since the commencement of our operations, we have developed good standing relationships with our customers. We also engage actively with our suppliers to improve our supply chain processes.

Following is the revenue bifurcation through B2B and B2C segment for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the financial years ended March 31, 2026, March 31, 2025 and March 31, 2024 have been provided below:

Company, by way of their certificate dated  October 15, 2026.

Our Company carries out its operations from its registered office situated at C 64, DDA Shed, Okhla Ind Area PH 1, South Delhi, New Delhi, Delhi- 110020, India covering an approximate area of  6,264 sq. ft. and has warehouse facilities, located at Plot No. 731/734, J- Block, Prem Nagar, Lal Kuan, Molar Band Road, Badarpur, Delhi- 110044, India and Plot No A-38, Vishwakarma Colony, MB Road, Lal Kuan, New Delhi, Delhi- 110044, India  covering an approximate plot area of 9,072 sq. ft. and plot area of 4,500 sq. ft. respectively, to store our products being traded to ensure easy supply chain mechanism. Further, our company also have four virtual offices. For further details of properties taken on lease and operated by the company and their exact usage, please refer section titled “Our Properties” on page 224 of this Red Herring Prospectus. Our Company is also equipped with appropriate supply chain mechanism with separate divisions looking after the overall supply chain mechanism.

Based on the current initiatives, we have taken the following measures to further boost our sales, strengthen our supply chain, and promote diversification through backward integration with following acquisitions:

• Acquired 100% stake of Dalmia Technologies Limited (“DTL”), in the year 2025 by entering into a Share Transfer Agreement and Memorandum of Understanding dated May 25, 2025 respectively. DTL was incorporated on January 10, 2023, and is engaged in the business of manufacturing including production, processing, fabrication, assembling, repairing, alternation, buying, importing, marketing, selling, exporting, and/or otherwise dealing of LED TVs and trading of other electronic products. For further details relating to the above detailed acquisitions and business activities of WOS, see “History and Certain Corporate Matters” and “Our Subsidiary” on page 233 and 265 of this Red Herring Prospectus.

• Further, with the above acquisition, Company creates a synergy effect, since the management intends to Invest in WOS, Dalmia Technologies Limited through Financing the capital expenditure towards Plant and Machinery and funding its incremental working capital requirements, which will generate funds, goodwill and business growth of our Company as well.

• Further, DTL also proposes to enhance its backward integration through the installation of Two set of Surface Mount Technology (SMT) Production Lines for assembly of Printed Circuit Board along with supporting ancillary accessories. For details relating to the above backward integration, see “Objects of the Offer” on page 99 of this Red Herring Prospectus.

Our Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing including production, processing, fabrication, assembling, repairing, alternation, buying, importing, marketing, selling, exporting, and/or otherwise dealing of LED TVs and trading of other electronic products and carries out its operations from its registered office and manufacturing unit located at A-97/1, Okhla Industrial Area Phase-II, New Delhi, South Delhi, Delhi, 110020, India with total covered area of facility on all floors including basement measuring of approximately 22,950 sq.ft. The exact details of the Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company’s properties, please refer below the section titled “Our Properties” on page 220. The facility of our WOS, Dalmia Technologies Limited is also equipped with the necessary workforce.

Our Company maintains a base of reliable suppliers who consistently provide Consumer electronics of appropriate quality as per our requirements. We usually do not enter into long-term supply contracts with any of our suppliers. We procure our products from domestic market based on the purchases made for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the financial years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024.

Beyond product sales, our Company provides after-sales services for our electronic products, including installation and repair, undertaken without charge for products covered under warranty and with charges for products that are outside the coverage of warranty through a network of third-party service providers. While the after-sales services are delivered by independent service providers, our Company remains focused on ensuring customer satisfaction.

To oversee our sales operations across PAN India, we have a dedicated Sales team operating from our Registered Office. The Sales team is responsible for securing orders from customers and negotiating terms that benefit the Company. Additionally, they play an active role in our marketing initiatives by conducting market research and collecting market intelligence.

Our Company adhere to follow strict quality standards along with the necessary approvals to ensure our customers receive the same level of quality.

Our Company deals in following Consumer electronics From the wide range of applications of consumer electronics that have been mentioned above, we know that consumer electronics tend to play a major role in everyone’s lives. However, it isn’t only because of its uses that it’s imperative. Our company caters to such products which makes our lives more convenient and efficient and caters to necessity products. Consumer electronics not only help to fulfill our individual needs, but they also help with the growth of our economy as a whole because with the growing advent of technology, innovation and modernity, and that’s where electronics plays a vital role.

Consumer electronics are electronic devices intended for everyday household use. Consumer electronics include LED TVs, Air coolers, Air conditioner, washing machine, etc. that are used for entertainment, communications, recreation and others.

risks.body:
- Our business operations rely significantly on the continuous and timely supply of products from top 5 and top 10 suppliers.
- Our purchases of stock-in-trade from top 10 suppliers are 99.77%, 99.33%, 99.82% and 99.97% for the period ended June 30, 2026 and for the fiscal years 2026, 2025 and 2024 respectively on the basis of Restated Standalone Financial Statements, accordingly, this exposes us to a concentration of purchases from top 10 suppliers and also, any interruptions or discontinuation of same will adversely impact our overall performance and profitability.
- Our products are marketed under our flagship brand, “Wiscon,” serving both (B-to-B) and (B-to-C) customers within India.
- We usually do not enter into long-term supply contracts with any of our suppliers.
- We procure these products typically through purchase orders which sets out the terms and conditions in relation to quantity, pricing and delivery details and do not enter into any continuing and exclusive supply agreements with our suppliers.
- If our suppliers do not perform their obligations in a timely manner or cease operations or decide to discontinue our supply relationships, or at all, we would need to find alternative suppliers, within a requisite span of time.
- While we have not experienced any instance where any of our suppliers did not fulfil their obligations in a timely manner in the last three Fiscals and for the period ended on June 30, 2026 that resulted in an adverse impact on our operations, we cannot assure that such instances will not arise in the future.
- Although we have not experienced any instances during the last three years and for the period ended on June 30, 2026 where our Company faced shortages, delayed deliveries or supply disruptions from our key suppliers where they were unable to supply us desired quantities of products or where we could not find a replacement for any particular supplier in the last three Fiscals and for the period ended on June 30, 2026, we cannot assure you that such instances will not arise in future.
